verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's platform supports recurring, event-triggered 'flows' (automations) per docs-11/17/19, and the MCP server lets an AI agent create campaigns (docs-9/10), but there is no evidence of AI-native scheduling of recurring jobs (e.g., via API or MCP) beyond one-off campaign creation. missing for 10: API/MCP documentation showing an agent can create or manage recurring/scheduled flows, cron-like scheduling controls, or agent-driven automation management beyond simple campaign creation.
